new.s: Pesticide use in Andhra Pradesh fell from 2,650 MT in 2014-15 to about how much in 2024-25?
new.x: AP's pesticide use fell from 2,650 MT (2014-15) to 1,716 MT (2024-25).

new.s: In which year was the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme introduced?
new.x: NBS (2010) gives a fixed per-kg subsidy on N, P, K and S for decontrolled P&K fertilisers.
